name: New Prairie Solar
description: We are primarily a general contractor focused on exceptional customer service. We avoid cold calling and aggressive sales, allowing you to approach us at your convenience for education and guidance. From initial contact through post-installation monitoring and servicing, your solar PV system will be handled by our in-house solar and construction teams, in partnership with our long-standing preferred licensed electrician. Our in-house designers, technicians and installers will find the best placement and size for your array, prioritizing quality and aesthetics, with no shortcuts taken. We will walk you through available incentives and ensure you receive outlined information in an easy-to-read contract.  We will complete your installation in a timely manner and offer a genuine guarantee for your system’s lifespan.
